package fixture

import "notary/internal/record"

// Assigning to record.GenesisHash must not compile. GenesisHash is a function,
// not a package variable, so no caller in any package can reassign the genesis
// anchor and silently redefine where a chain starts -- which would make chain
// verification accept or reject the wrong genesis link.
func redefineGenesis() {
	record.GenesisHash = record.Hash{}
}
